name: Avatares AI - Admin - Delete Ingest Profile

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
  SELECT NULLIF('{{ String($json.body?.profileId || $json.body?.profile_id || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '') AS profile_id_text
),
target AS (
  SELECT p.*
  FROM ingest_profiles p
  JOIN input i ON p.profile_id::text = i.profile_id_text
  LIMIT 1
),
asset_check AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS asset_count
  FROM canonical_asset_registry a
  JOIN target t
    ON a.avatar = t.avatar
   AND a.scene = t.scene
   AND a.asset_type = t.asset_type
),
deleted AS (
  DELETE FROM ingest_profiles p
  USING target t, asset_check ac
  WHERE p.profile_id = t.profile_id
    AND ac.asset_count = 0
  RETURNING p.*
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT profile_id_text FROM input) IS NULL THEN false
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target) THEN false
    WHEN (SELECT asset_count FROM asset_check) > 0 THEN false
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deleted) THEN true
    ELSE false
  END AS ok,

  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT profile_id_text FROM input) IS NULL THEN 'Missing profileId'
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target) THEN 'Profile not found'
    WHEN (SELECT asset_count FROM asset_check) > 0 THEN
      'This profile cannot be deleted because assets already exist for it.'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deleted) THEN NULL
    ELSE 'Profile could not be deleted'
  END AS error,

  COALESCE((SELECT asset_count FROM asset_check), 0) AS asset_count,

  (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'profileId', profile_id,
      'profileName', profile_name,
      'avatar', avatar,
      'avatarShort', avatar_short,
      'scene', scene,
      'assetType', asset_type,
      'workflow', workflow,
      'model', model,
      'seed', seed,
      'version', version,
      'autoPromoteLatest', auto_promote_latest,
      'isActive', is_active,
      'isEnabled', is_enabled,
      'createdAt', created_at,
      'updatedAt', updated_at
    )
    FROM target
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS profile,

  (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'profileId', profile_id,
      'profileName', profile_name,
      'avatar', avatar,
      'scene', scene,
      'assetType', asset_type
    )
    FROM deleted
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS deleted_profile;
